title: Ren · Animal Flow
description: A tiled corridor and a lavish table give way to masked figures, a crown and a close rap performance.

performance.lyrics: duh, duh, duh, flow You're in the mind of a cannibal king My chaos and anarchy roam In trouble is bubbling under the skin A certain insanity shows Whenever I pick up the mic and begin whenever these words that I write with my pen come alive they ignite like I pulled out the pen Animal slow, out in the jungle I'm ready for war I'm beating your brains with a bat I'm swinging it back and spooky Your bag's on board Know that they're cannibals, A murderous mind that you can't ignore Await and riabic combat on the counter Attack on the king of the jungle, librar Ah Ah Ah I'm animal, I'm a flow CEO, I've got mountains of murderous brines Mountain volcanic, blow and cause mayhem and panic There's nowhere to run from my mind I'm an impossible phone ever slowing Just growing and flowing with intricate lines Yes, I will dig in my teeth when I bite like a beast. Blood, I drink it like wine. Animal flow, rah! Out in the wilderness I will be king Sit on my throne on the Lord of the Rings Out on my own and my terrible thing Animal skins, over my shoulder's like bling They will be clothing my sins I came to win Over and over again I'll take your life with the Quinn Ah Ah that, I didn't get that wrong I don't know, I didn' t get that, I get the wrong I don't know, I didn''t that, didn''t blood it flows horrific explicit i be parasitic i sit there commencing your flesh don't fidget on living no mentally with it i get kinda sick when im stressed yum yum yum yum i am the eye I am the storm, am the fury, am the scorn, am the belly, am the beast Yes I am, yes I am, yes I am, Yes I'm an animal, Yes I'm an animal Yes, sometimes the things I say are irrational Yes, sometimes I think that you are quite radical Yes, will be waging war on the capital Yes, will burn the houses of parliament down Cos hypocrites they burn quite easily Wow! Burn and pillage it all to the ground Your illegitimate king lost his crown Ah Ah I will be cruel, drown on my foes in a paddling pool, yes I'm tyrannical bro, never mistake, I'm an Ah I'll take your ignorance right back to school and teach you a lesson for testing my cool.
